'''CT-R3C''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
CT-R3C appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a vendor for refunding unused unassembled gear pieces, added to both Imperial and Republic fleets with patch 5.2.1.
